notes: Original research paper (Energy Environ. Sci. 2011, 4, 195; 'PAPER'); no retraction notice in the PDF and is_retracted is false; no statement that the H2 data were published before. Sorbents: pristine 3D graphene (GP, from thermally exfoliated graphite oxide) and Ni-B-doped GP (Ni 0.83-2.41 wt%, B 0.69-1.39 wt% by ICP-ES), all majority carbon. Volumetric H2 isotherms at 77 K (up to 106 kPa, Fig. 4), 273 K (Fig. 5) and 87 K (for isosteric heat). BET areas measured by N2 at 77 K for GP (477 m2/g) and GP-Ni0.83B1.09 (272 m2/g); the 2630 m2/g 'Perfect Graphene' row in Table 1 is a cited theoretical value, not a measured sample.
